source: I want a soccer game with bots to play if there's no one to play with I want spawn to be a field with a world cup trophy in the middle of spawn then I want a shop so you can buy celebrations and dance then I want a goalkeeper to guard the goal. then I want rounds of 32,16 quarter final semi finals and then finals. If there is a tie it goes to penalty shootout up to 5 tries to win. Then I was a crowd around the stadium and hear cheering for the teams I want to have a flag pick between France Spain Portugal Argentina New Zealand America Canada Morocco Cape Verde Brazil England Uruguay Croatia Germany Norway. You can choose between any team and swap at any time not in the middle of gameplay though. then I want a shop so people can buy a flag to play 2,500 for Argentina 2,500 for other countries. You earn 250 in game coins for every win. Everytime you goal 10 coins. I want a cheer for the winner of the final. And a flag of Spain for them winning the 2026 world cup.

answers.ask: Should the stadium read as a real modern World Cup venue, or stylized and cartoonish?
answers.answer: Use a real modern World Cup-style stadium, with a large crowd, national flags, and the Spain 2026 winner presentation.

answers.ask: Is the pitch regulation size with full stands, or a compact arcade-sized pitch?
answers.answer: Use a compact arcade-sized pitch with full stands so rounds are quick and easy to play.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D soccer stadium map styled as a modern World Cup venue, centered on a compact arcade-sized regulation-style pitch with two goals and a goalkeeper positioned at each goal. Full spectator stands tightly surround the field, packed with a large crowd and decorated with national flags representing the selectable teams. At the spawn area, place a World Cup-style trophy as the central landmark, with a nearby shop building or kiosk. Include a finals presentation area featuring Spanish flags and a Spain 2026 winner display.
blob:
### 1. Genre
The dominant genre is Sports: a soccer match with formal goals, rounds, and a championship final.

### 2. Shape and preset
Use `space-bounded`, a compact arcade-sized regulation-style soccer pitch enclosed by a modern World Cup stadium. Match the Field Sport preset, supplemented by the Full Stadium presentation elements requested: the pitch remains the active field while full stands surround it.

### 3. Config requirements
Use `trigger-bounds` as clear touchlines, goal lines, and a rigid active-field perimeter. Use `startpoint-play` as the centre spot and organized team restart positions. Use `trigger-scoring` as visible goal mouths with scoring planes. Use `barrier-perimeter` as the stadium boundary behind and around the stands. Use `spectator-bleachers` as full, tightly wrapping tiered spectator stands. Use `npc-population` for the packed cheering crowd and the two goalkeeper characters, one guarding each goal. Render national flags throughout the stadium, including France, Spain, Portugal, Argentina, New Zealand, America, Canada, Morocco, Cape Verde, Brazil, England, Uruguay, Croatia, Germany, and Norway.

### 4. Layout requirements
Place `trigger-bounds` continuously around the pitch perimeter. Place one `startpoint-play` at the centre circle, with balanced restart positions on each half. Place two `trigger-scoring` volumes, one precisely inside each goal mouth. Site `npc-population` across all stand tiers, with two goalkeeper NPC placements centered immediately in front of their respective goal lines. Place an arrival spawn marker in the entry forecourt beside the trophy landmark, outside the active pitch. No additional placed gameplay pickups are required.

### 5. Layout components
The central zone is one compact green soccer pitch with a centre circle, halfway line, penalty boxes, two full goals, and clear painted boundary lines. A trophy spawn forecourt sits at the main stadium entrance, with a large World Cup-style trophy at its centre and a small shop kiosk adjacent to it. The finals presentation zone occupies one end of the stadium beyond the stands or sideline, with a winner podium, Spanish flags, and a prominent Spain 2026 champion display. Tiered stands tightly ring the field and hold the crowd; national banners decorate the façade and seating bowl. Keep circulation on a perimeter concourse linking the spawn forecourt, shop, stands, and presentation area. Frame the whole venue symmetrically around the pitch, with the trophy and Spain presentation readable as secondary focal points.

### 6. Render order
Use `topdown` first and treat it as authoritative, because exact field boundaries, goal placement, restart positions, and scoring volumes must align cleanly for playable soccer.

### 7. Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium: the pitch is compact for quick rounds, but full spectator stands and entry/presentation spaces expand the venue. Theme is a realistic modern World Cup stadium, dense with crowd energy, national flags, and a Spain 2026 championship presentation. Apply `tiered` because the raked spectator seating has real stepped elevation without overhangs.
